dialogue.text: You've got to be kidding me! I'm telling you Sweets is the best!
dialogue.textjp: いい加減にしてよね！！スイーツが一番って言ってるでしょ！！

dialogue.text: They have no comprehension, seriously! I told you meat is the high road!
dialogue.textjp: わかんねぇ奴だなマジで！！肉が王道だって言ってんだろ！！

dialogue.text: It's too high road, there's no interest in it!
dialogue.textjp: 王道過ぎて面白みがねぇんだよ！

dialogue.text: Hey, take back what you just said...!
dialogue.textjp: おい聞き捨てならねぇな...！

dialogue.text: Hey, hey, hey, the beach will become a battlefield!
dialogue.textjp: おいおいおいビーチが戦場になっちまう！！

dialogue.text: I'll take care of your weapons for a while!
dialogue.textjp: しばらく武器は俺が預かるからな！！
あっおいテメェ余計な世話を！！

dialogue.text: Ha! One fist is enough for you all!
dialogue.textjp: ハッ！テメェらなんか拳一個で足りるってんだよ雑魚がよォ！

dialogue.text: I'll just dodge your fist and be done with it! Is your brain just for decoration?
dialogue.textjp: アンタのその拳なんてちょっとかわして終了よ！！その脳はお飾りかしらぁ！？

dialogue.text: Damn it, BF! That's my prized possession, hold on to it!
dialogue.textjp: チッ！！BF！そりゃあ俺の大事なモンだ、しっかり持ってろよ！

dialogue.text: If you break any of my things, I won't accept it!
dialogue.textjp: 私の物壊したら承知しないんだから！

dialogue.text: How am I supposed to break something this strong
dialogue.textjp: こんな屈強すぎるもん俺にどう壊せと

dialogue.text: Let's get this over with already! I'm hungry indeed!
dialogue.textjp: もう早くケリ付けようぜ！さすがに腹減った！！
